purpose: Preserve the original formal failure while correcting caller threshold semantics and separating wrapper overhead from process-to-process timing variation.

integration.full_pipeline_trigger: min(frozen rescue trigger_score, actual case minimum detection score)
integration.reason: A match already accepted by the caller's threshold does not need low-score rescue.

paired_diagnostic.selection: All original formal easy-case overhead failures with zero retry parents; selected using the already saved report, never geometric truth.
paired_diagnostic.schedule: Each round contains old_baseline/rescue/rescue/old_baseline and new_baseline/rescue/rescue/new_baseline. Reverse each ABBA on odd rounds and alternate which pair runs first.
metrics: C API wall minus nested baseline_ms
paired_diagnostic.memory_limit: Three live contexts share one process. Its peak RSS is not comparable to single-handle fresh-process RSS; owned buffers are reported separately.

acceptance.all_outputs: Exact frozen CPU scores, original seed bounds, monotonic score, unchanged precision gates, bounded work; no retry parents in paired diagnostic.
acceptance.src7: Every first/repeated result must match frozen same-backend detections uniquely within 2px/1degree/2%; agreement is not ground truth.
acceptance.full_pipeline_overhead: Warm median increase <= max(10% of matching baseline, 2ms).
acceptance.paired_no_retry_overhead: Median ABBA-paired increase <= max(10% of paired baseline, 0.5ms); report both frozen and same-binary baseline comparisons separately.
acceptance.interpretation: This follow-up cannot rewrite the original formal failure. No claim of universal speedup or global NCC optimality.
